# INV-NNN: <Investigation title>

> **Template (non-authoritative).** Copy to `docs/investigations/INV-NNN-<kebab-title>.md`. Investigations recommend; they do not decide.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| ID | INV-NNN |
| Title | |
| Status | Planned |
| Owner | project-owner |
| Created | YYYY-MM-DD |
| Updated | YYYY-MM-DD |

*The specific question to answer.*
